from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import ast, hashlib, importlib.util, json, re, subprocess

root = Path('/workspace/scratch/101d52695253/AI-GPU')
base = root.parent
digest = lambda raw: hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
reader_path = root / 'docs/project/evidence/p05-torch/reviews/archive_reader.py'
reader_sha = '4144becd4fe3c829380f7e66cdb66f7cf073b5e189c2620cd60c62940b9317d3'
assert digest(reader_path.read_bytes()) == reader_sha
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('a33_trusted_reader', reader_path)
api = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(api)

def git_bytes(rev, rel):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', rev + ':' + rel], cwd=root)

def constants(raw, selected):
    return {n.targets[0].id: ast.literal_eval(n.value) for n in ast.parse(raw).body
            if isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and len(n.targets) == 1
            and isinstance(n.targets[0], ast.Name) and n.targets[0].id in selected}

def canonical(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False) + '\n').encode()

source_paths = ['ci/project/p05_torch_host_tests.py', 'python/vortex_ai/torch_ops.py',
                'python/vortex_ai/_api.py', 'ci/project/test_p05_python_api.py']
review_paths = source_paths + [
    'ci/project/p05_torch_native_host_tests.py', 'ci/project/p05_test_runtime.py',
    'ci/project/fixtures/p05_python_runtime.cpp', 'ci/project/p05_torch_replay.py',
    'docs/project/roadmap.json', 'docs/project/acceptance.md',
    'docs/project/p05-torch-compatibility.md', 'docs/designs/torch_custom_ops_v1.md',
    'docs/designs/torch_archive_replay_v1.md']
before = {p: digest((root / p).read_bytes()) for p in review_paths}
result = {'agent': 'a33', 'scope': 'independent-inert-supplementary-host-evidence-review',
          'acceptance_claimed': False, 'native_execution': 'not_run',
          'retained_code_executed': False, 'reader_sha256': reader_sha,
          'reader_revision': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=root, text=True).strip(),
          'reviewed_sources': before, 'archives': []}
archives = [
    ('c0', 'fp16', 'c0b44ce64665fe11895f869eea8c38c9b820d6f7', '8c42f7e9f310972e2c0c67c56a03ce8f5460d706cb8dc3a5397435445ea6737c'),
    ('c0', 'bf16', 'c0b44ce64665fe11895f869eea8c38c9b820d6f7', '787fd1b41a27da8c100277613c581ba734920fd45b13e0707ba0f9ea2e866330'),
    ('c6', 'fp16', 'c6fb039e706e812b6b3f4d2a5db1828076fe50df', 'd9e9a713ef716882086b6c8176d1d27c4c98acae77110c58f84bdb69a00c4aaa'),
    ('c6', 'bf16', 'c6fb039e706e812b6b3f4d2a5db1828076fe50df', '85498037f9a8b06bbb44357208f236ad325dc686934059bc472348c4524a74b3')]

for label, fmt, revision, original_sha in archives:
    path = base / 'originals' / f'p05-torch-{fmt}-{revision[:8]}-original.zip'
    with api.ArchiveReader(path, original_sha) as archive:
        v = archive.view()
        names = set(v.files())
        host = v.json('torch-host.json')
        fault = v.json('torch-native-host/report.json')
        host_source = git_bytes(revision, source_paths[0])
        tree = ast.parse(host_source)
        const = constants(host_source, {'FORMATS', 'SHAPES'})
        cls = next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) and n.name == 'HostTorchTests')
        direct = [n.name for n in cls.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name.startswith('test_')]
        dynamic = ['test_signature_' + f + '_' + 'x'.join(map(str, shape))
                   for f in const['FORMATS'] for shape in const['SHAPES']]
        dynamic += ['test_all_16bit_encodings_' + f for f in const['FORMATS']]
        expected = sorted('__main__.HostTorchTests.' + name for name in direct + dynamic)
        assert len(expected) == len(set(expected)) == 45
        observed = [r['test'] for r in host['tests']]
        assert observed == expected
        assert all(r['outcome'] == 'pass' and r['duration_seconds'] >= 0 for r in host['tests'])
        for k, value in {'tests_run': 45, 'failures': 0, 'errors': 0, 'skips': 0, 'outcome': 'pass',
                         'torch_version': '2.15.0+cpu', 'python_version': '3.12.14',
                         'native_execution': 'not_run', 'acceptance_claimed': False}.items():
            assert host[k] == value
        raw = v.read('torch-host.log').decode()
        starts = list(re.finditer(r'^(test_\w+) \((__main__\.HostTorchTests\.test_\w+)\) \.\.\. ', raw, re.M))
        assert [m.group(2) for m in starts] == expected
        for i, match in enumerate(starts):
            assert match.group(2).endswith('.' + match.group(1))
            end = starts[i + 1].start() if i + 1 < len(starts) else raw.index('\n----------------------------------------------------------------------', match.end())
            assert raw[match.end():end].rstrip().endswith('ok')
        assert re.search(r'\nRan 45 tests in [0-9.]+s\n\nOK\n', raw)
        summary = api.strict_json(raw.split('P05_TORCH_HOST ', 1)[1].encode())
        assert summary == {k: host[k] for k in ('scope', 'outcome', 'torch_version', 'tests_run', 'failures', 'errors', 'skips')}
        assert len(host['source_files']) == 4
        host_sources, producer_root = [], None
        for row, rel in zip(host['source_files'], source_paths):
            assert row['path'].endswith('/' + rel)
            prefix = row['path'][:-len('/' + rel)]
            if producer_root is None:
                producer_root = prefix
            assert prefix == producer_root
            b = git_bytes(revision, rel)
            assert digest(b) == row['sha256'] == digest((root / rel).read_bytes())
            retained = [n for n in names if n.endswith('/' + rel)]

            host_sources.append({'path': rel, 'sha256': row['sha256'],
                                 'matches_selected_git_revision': True, 'retained_source_members': sorted(retained)})
        snap = v.read('torch-native-host/test.snapshot.py')
        trusted = git_bytes(revision, 'ci/project/p05_torch_native_host_tests.py')
        assert snap == trusted == (root / 'ci/project/p05_torch_native_host_tests.py').read_bytes()
        assert digest(snap) == fault['test_sha256']
        scenarios = constants(snap, {'SCENARIOS'})['SCENARIOS']
        assert len(scenarios) == len(set(scenarios)) == 9
        assert [r['scenario'] for r in fault['results']] == list(scenarios)
        for k, value in {'outcome': 'pass', 'completed': 9, 'scenario_count': 9, 'child_timeout_seconds': 30,
                         'format': fmt, 'backend_execution': 'not_run', 'native_accelerator_execution': 'not_run',
                         'acceptance_claimed': False}.items():
            assert fault[k] == value
        assert fault['python_version'].startswith('3.12.14 ')
        assert v.read('torch-native-host.log').decode() == ''.join(n + ': pass\n' for n in scenarios)
        manifest_raw = v.read('torch-native-host/runtime/bundle/manifest.json')
        manifest = api.strict_json(manifest_raw)
        assert manifest == fault['build']['manifest'] and digest(manifest_raw) == fault['build']['manifest_sha256']
        assert manifest['source_revision'] == revision and manifest['format'] == fmt
        assert manifest['contract_id'] == 'p05-host-only-fault-bundle-v1' and manifest['schema_version'] == 0
        assert manifest['arithmetic'] == 'synthetic-pattern-or-immutable-fixture-response'
        assert manifest['source_sha256'] == digest(canonical(manifest['binding_sources']))
        runtime_raw = git_bytes(revision, 'ci/project/p05_test_runtime.py')
        runtime_tree = ast.parse(runtime_raw)
        runtime_constants = constants(runtime_raw, {'EXTENSION_SOURCES', 'INCLUDE_DIRS'})
        git_names = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', revision], cwd=root, text=True).splitlines()
        expected_sources = set(runtime_constants['EXTENSION_SOURCES']) | {'ci/project/p05_test_runtime.py', 'ci/project/fixtures/p05_python_runtime.cpp'}
        for n in git_names:

                expected_sources.add(n)
        assert [r['path'] for r in manifest['binding_sources']] == sorted(expected_sources)
        manifest_sources = []
        for r in manifest['binding_sources']:
            b = git_bytes(revision, r['path'])
            assert (digest(b), len(b)) == (r['sha256'], r['size'])
            retained = [n for n in names if n.endswith('/' + r['path'])]
            for n in retained:
                assert v.read(n) == b
            if r['path'].startswith('python/vortex_ai/'):
                copied = 'torch-native-host/runtime/' + r['path']
                assert v.read(copied) == b
                retained.append(copied)
            manifest_sources.append({**r, 'matches_selected_git_revision': True,
                                     'retained_source_members': sorted(set(retained))})
        for r in manifest['artifacts']:
            b = v.read('torch-native-host/runtime/bundle/' + r['path'])
            assert (digest(b), len(b)) == (r['sha256'], r['size'])
        assert len(manifest['artifacts']) == 6
        extension_name = 'torch-native-host/runtime/python/vortex_ai/_native.cpython-312-x86_64-linux-gnu.so'
        assert v.identity(extension_name)['sha256'] == fault['build']['extension_sha256']
        commands = v.json('torch-native-host/runtime/build_commands.json')['commands']
        assert commands == fault['build']['commands'] and len(commands) == 7
        for c in commands[:6]:
            assert '-fsanitize=undefined' in c and '-fno-sanitize-recover=undefined' in c
        build_log = v.read('torch-native-host/runtime/build.log').decode()
        raw_commands = [api.strict_json(line.encode()) for line in build_log.splitlines() if line.startswith('[')]
        assert raw_commands == commands
        known_symbols = next(n for n in runtime_tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.Assign)
                             and isinstance(n.targets[0], ast.Name) and n.targets[0].id == 'VX_FUNCTIONS')
        expected_symbols = set(ast.literal_eval(known_symbols.value.args[0]))

        scenario_rows = []
        for row in fault['results']:

            ob = api.strict_json(stdout)
            assert ob == row['observations'] and row['exit_code'] == 0 and row['outcome'] == 'pass'
            assert ob['scenario'] == name and ob['format'] == fmt and ob['scope'] == fault['scope']
            assert ob['outcome'] == 'pass' and ob['torch_version'] == '2.15.0+cpu'
            command = v.json(prefix + '/command.json')
            launcher = v.read(prefix + '/launcher.py').decode()
            assert command['argv'][1] == '-c' and len(command['argv']) == 3 and command['argv'][2] == launcher
            assert command['timeout_seconds'] == 30 and command['scope'] == fault['scope']
            assert command['argv'][0] == '/home/runner/work/_temp/p05-torch/torch-work/venv/bin/python'
            snapshot_path = '/home/runner/work/_temp/p05-torch/evidence/torch-native-host/test.snapshot.py'

            assert launcher == expected_launcher

            assert ob['extension_file'] == runtime_path + '/python/vortex_ai/_native.cpython-312-x86_64-linux-gnu.so'
            counters = ob['counters']

            assert all(n == 0 for owner in counters['owners'].values() for n in owner.values())
            assert counters['contract_errors'] == counters['premature'] == counters['input_copy_mismatches'] == 0
            assert counters['max_live_devices'] <= 1
            if name == 'fixed_models':
                assert counters['fixture_inputs_checked'] == 15 and counters['launches_observed'] == 15
            if name == 'matmul_shapes':

            if name == 'cleanup_failure':

            scenario_rows.append({'scenario': name, 'exit_code': row['exit_code'], 'outcome': row['outcome'],

                                  'counter_summary': {k: counters[k] for k in ('resources', 'premature', 'contract_errors',
                                      'input_copy_mismatches', 'max_live_devices', 'fixture_inputs_checked', 'launches_observed')},
                                  'metrics': ob['metrics']})
        receipt = archive.receipt()
        entry = {'label': label, 'format': fmt, 'execution_revision': revision, 'archive_sha256': original_sha,
                 'host': {'test_count': 45, 'unique_tests': len(set(observed)), 'direct_source_test_methods': len(direct),
